note: Regression tripwires, not taste. A threshold here says 'a render this far out is worth a listener's ear before it ships'; none says a sound is good. Every number was chosen after looking at the shipped renders (see README), and every waiver names the reason and a follow-up.

rules.why: NaN or Inf in a render
samples beyond +/-1.0 clip at a converter
a span of 1 s or more that goes nowhere in level or timbre (the song-swarm collapse shape)
integrated loudness within 6 LU of full scale
nearly inaudible next to the rest of the set
first sample within 40 dB of the peak (and above -70 dBFS) later than 25 ms after note-on
a notification louder than -12 or quieter than -40 LUFS
a notification within 6 dB of full scale
a notification whose first sample within 40 dB of the peak comes later than 5 ms after note-on
first-note attack slower than 12 ms (DingCatalog notes attack in 1-6 ms)
spiky next to its own body
DingCatalog forbids broadband noise; A-weighted noise should clearly not dominate tone (heuristic split: gliding partials read as noise, so 10 not 0)
thruster low-rpm hiss: before the 2026-11-05 mix change this was 20.7 dB; the cap sits 2-3 dB over the 13.1 dB measured after it, so the hiss cannot creep back unnoticed
thruster low-rpm hiss: before the 2026-11-05 mix change this was 23.0 dB; the cap sits 2-3 dB over the 5.0 dB measured after it, so the hiss cannot creep back unnoticed
thruster low-rpm hiss: before the 2026-11-05 mix change this was 20.1 dB; the cap sits 2-3 dB over the 12.7 dB measured after it, so the hiss cannot creep back unnoticed
PRC SYNTH1 peaked at 2.10 before the 2026-11-05 gain trim to 0.67; this holds it under 0.9
